biological_support.statistical_interpretation: RNA shows a strong, coherent downregulation of metabolic and secretory pathways with 22 significant pathways and large negative SMDs (e.g., -1.45, -1.29), all with q<0.001. WXS mutation enrichment is not significant after FDR (all q>0.77), though VHL and BAP1 show moderate effect sizes with wide CIs. CNV continuous and gain/loss analyses show no significant q-values (min q=0.542); chr20q gain and chr5p gain have ORs >2.9 but CIs are wide and q-values are not significant. Overall, RNA provides strong biological signal, while WXS and CNV provide weak, non-significant trends.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: The set is characterized by reduced expression of metabolic and secretory programs, which may reflect a distinct tumor metabolic state. Mutation and CNV patterns are not statistically robust and should be interpreted cautiously.
limitations: WXS and CNV analyses have limited power due to small set size (n=20) and multiple testing; CIs are wide.
RNA findings are based on ssGSEA scores and may be influenced by tumor purity.

Gain/loss analysis shows no significant q-values, but CDKN2A loss is absent in set vs 29.8% rest (q=0.075). Overall, CNV provides the strongest biological signal, with RNA and WXS providing weaker support.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: The set shows a distinct copy-number loss pattern involving multiple chromosomal regions, which may be biologically relevant. PBRM1 mutation enrichment is suggestive but not FDR-significant.
limitations: WXS and RNA findings are not FDR-significant; CNV continuous findings are significant but gain/loss analysis is not.
Small set size (n=19) limits precision.
